faq.question: What industries does XAIVON specialize in?
faq.answer: XAIVON specializes in logistics, freight operations, supply chain, and data-heavy environments where manual handoffs create operational friction.

faq.question: How does XAIVON pricing work?
faq.answer: XAIVON publishes transparent starting implementation tiers on xaivon.com/pricing across 6 core service areas (e.g., Workflow Automation starting at $749 USD / ₹29,000 INR; Chatbot Systems starting at $1,249 USD / ₹49,000 INR). Exact commercial quotes are custom-tailored following an operational discovery assessment with founder Raja Babu based on workflow scope, record volume, and integration endpoints.

faq.question: How long does implementation take?
faq.answer: Focused automations and conversational agents typically deploy in 1 to 2 weeks. Comprehensive multi-system pipelines generally require 3 to 6 weeks including sandbox verification and human review gates.

faq.question: How can I book a discovery consultation?
faq.answer: You can connect directly with founder Raja Babu at raja@xaivon.com (+91-95211-90205) or schedule a strategic consultation at https://calendly.com/xaivon.
